places.name: Golden Gate Bridge
places.description: Art Deco suspension bridge completed 1937, spanning 2.7km across the Golden Gate strait. International Orange paint chosen to enhance visibility in fog. Walk or cycle the 10km round-trip — free pedestrian access year-round.
highlights: Walk or bike the 2.7km span — free
Fort Baker vista point at south anchor
Fog-shrouded dawn is its most cinematic

places.name: Ferry Building Marketplace
places.description: 1898 Beaux-Arts ferry terminal transformed into SF's best food market. Acme sourdough, Blue Bottle Coffee, Cowgirl Creamery cheeses, Hog Island oysters. Tuesday and Saturday farmers market on the Embarcadero.
highlights: Cowgirl Creamery — Mt Tam triple-cream
Hog Island Oyster raw bar
Tuesday + Saturday outdoor farmers market

places.name: Alcatraz Island
places.description: Federal penitentiary 1934–1963, now a National Park. Night tours available in the cellhouse. Home of Al Capone and Robert Stroud 'Birdman.' Historic audio-guide narrated by former guards and inmates.
highlights: Audio tour narrated by former inmates
Night tour — cellhouse after dark
Al Capone's cell, block D isolation

places.name: Mission District Burritos
places.description: The Mission burrito — overstuffed foil-wrapped beast invented here in 1961. La Taqueria (James Beard winner), Taqueria El Farolito (4am), Papalote with avocado salsa. Murals on 24th St, Latin grocery stores, piñatas.
highlights: La Taqueria — James Beard Award-winning burrito
24th St BART murals — Chicano heritage
El Farolito open until 3am weekends

places.name: Chinatown Grant Avenue
places.description: Oldest Chinatown in North America (1848). Dragon's Gate on Bush Street, Fortune cookie factory (invented in SF, not China), Clarion Alley Dim Sum at City View. 24/7 produce markets and herb shops.
highlights: Fortune Cookie Factory — watch the bending
City View — best dim sum for groups
Rose Pak Dragon Gate at Chinatown's southern edge

places.name: Haight-Ashbury
places.description: Epicentre of the 1967 Summer of Love. Victorian painted ladies on Waller Street, Grateful Dead house at 710 Ashbury, Amoeba Records, Rasputin Music. Urban Outfitters-era Victorian houses alongside psychedelic murals.
highlights: 710 Ashbury — Grateful Dead house
Amoeba Music — 100,000 used vinyl
Summer of Love 1967 street signs

places.name: SFMOMA
places.description: San Francisco Museum of Modern Art — 45,000 works over 7 floors after 2016 expansion. Matisse, Calder, Rauschenberg, Cindy Sherman, Garry Winogrand. Largest Dorothea Lange photography collection.
highlights: Dorothea Lange — largest collection in the world
Calder mobiles in the light-filled atrium
Free Thursday evenings 1st Thursday of month

places.name: Tartine Bakery
places.description: The most influential sourdough bakery in the US, credited with reviving American artisan bread. Country loaf emerges at 5pm, sells out by 5:30pm. Chad Robertson's croissants serve as the California counterpoint to Paris.
highlights: Country loaf at 5pm — sells out in 30min
Croissants said to rival Paris
Morning bun with orange zest — queue at 8am
